title: Work Vocabulary + Collocations
grammarNote:
Коллокации (collocations) — устойчивые словосочетания. Нельзя просто перевести дословно!

📌 HAVE: have a meeting · have an interview · have a break · have experience
📌 DO: do business · do research · do a project · do overtime · do well
📌 MAKE: make a decision · make progress · make a mistake · make a profit
📌 TAKE: take responsibility · take notes · take action · take part in

⚠️ Ошибки дословного перевода:
❌ "Do a mistake" → ✅ "Make a mistake"
❌ "Make research" → ✅ "Do research"
❌ "Have a decision" → ✅ "Make a decision"

💡 Учи коллокации как единую фразу, а не по отдельным словам!

grammarTip:
Главное правило коллокаций: учи как ЕДИНУЮ фразу!

DO: homework · research · exercise · business · the dishes · your best
MAKE: a mistake · progress · a decision · money · a presentation · an effort
HAVE: a meeting · a break · a conversation · lunch · experience · fun
TAKE: notes · responsibility · action · a break · part (in) · a risk

🎯 Тест (какой глагол?):
___ a report? → write
___ a deadline? → meet
___ a salary? → earn / receive
___ a promotion? → get / receive

exercises.text: She ___ for three jobs last week.
exercises.hint: "apply for a job" is the correct collocation.

exercises.text: Don't ___ the deadline — submit by Friday.
exercises.hint: "miss a deadline" = fail to submit on time.

exercises.text: He ___ as a software engineer for a startup.
exercises.hint: "work as + profession": works as a software engineer.

exercises.text: She ___ a presentation to the whole department.
After five years, she ___ a promotion.
exercises.hint: "get a promotion" = receive a higher position.

exercises.text: "Do a meeting" is a correct work collocation.
exercises.hint: Correct: "attend a meeting" or "have a meeting." Not "do".

exercises.text: Take a short ___ before the interview — it helps you relax.
He ___ a salary of 400,000 tenge per month.
We are working ___ a new app for university students.
exercises.hint: "work on + project" = be engaged in a task.

exercises.text: Which is NOT a work collocation?
exercises.hint: "do a salary" is not used. You "earn a salary" or "receive a salary".

exercises.text: "Apply for a job" is a correct collocation.
exercises.hint: "apply for a job" ✅ — standard fixed expression.

questions.hint: "apply for" = to formally request a job or position.

questions.text: She ___ a presentation at the company conference.

questions.hint: "work in" + sector/industry: work in healthcare, IT, education.

questions.text: "Do a meeting" is a standard work collocation.
questions.hint: Correct collocation: "attend a meeting" or "have a meeting."

questions.text: He ___ his first job right after graduating from WKU.
Don't ___ the deadline — it's tomorrow at midnight.
questions.hint: "miss a deadline" = fail to complete something on time.

questions.text: "She works ___ a software engineer" — which preposition?
questions.hint: "work as + profession": She works as a doctor/engineer.

questions.text: She ___ a good salary at her new company.
They are working ___ a new project for a client in Germany.
